title: Must-Do Thailand Family Tour | Islands & City Experiences
highlights: Enjoy comfortable, family-friendly stays in well-located 4-star hotels, close to markets & dining spots, so you can step out easily without travelling far.
Benefit from a well-planned holiday with a perfect balance of sightseeing & leisure time, so you & your family can relax and explore comfortably.
Cover 7 stunning islands of Krabi in a single island-hopping journey & witness the sea light up in a magical neon-blue glow after sunset.
Travel with ease with airport pickups, drop-offs, intercity & sightseeing transfers already arranged, making the trip for you & your family smooth & convenient.
overview:
About the Tour:
Enjoy a fun-filled Thailand holiday covering Phuket, Krabi & Bangkok in 7 Days with a perfect mix of islands, city sights & family-friendly experiences. Relax in Phuket, explore Patong & cruise by speedboat to the stunning Phi Phi Islands. Discover Big Buddha, viewpoints & Old Town before heading to Krabi for a magical 7 Islands sunset tour with Thai dinner & glowing plankton. Fly to Bangkok for a Chao Phraya dinner cruise & an exciting day at Safari World & Marine Park. End with the immersive Space & Time Cube visit & a smooth private airport transfer.

know_before_you_go: Travellers should carry a passport with a minimum of 6 months' validity from the date of departure and keep it easily accessible for hotel check-ins and domestic flights.
The Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) must be filled out online at least 3 days before travel at https://tdac.immigration.go.th
Indian travellers may be eligible for a Visa on Arrival or an e-Visa (as per prevailing rules) and should keep return tickets, hotel confirmations, and proof of funds ready for immigration.
It is recommended to carry at least 10,000 THB per adult in cash, as forex cards may not be accepted everywhere.
Hotel bed type is subject to availability and is usually confirmed only at the time of check-in.
Standard check-in and check-out timings will apply. Early check-in or late check-out may involve additional charges depending on availability.
Airport transfers are strictly point-to-point. Any extra stop or route change requested during the journey will be chargeable.
For transfers scheduled between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM, a night surcharge will apply, payable directly to the driver.
On shared transfers, the driver will wait up to 5 minutes, while for private transfers, the waiting time is up to 10 minutes only.
Shared transfers, boat tours, and sightseeing operate on fixed timings, and delays may result in missed services without compensation.
Island tours, ferries, and speedboats are subject to weather conditions, and schedules or routes may change in the interest of safety.
As island tours start early, hotel breakfast may be missed. Guests can request a packed or early breakfast from the hotel a day prior (subject to policy).
During island tours, a simple local Thai lunch is usually provided. Guests are advised to carry swimwear, a change of clothes, sunscreen, and a towel.
Pregnant women are generally not allowed to participate in island tours or certain adventure activities due to safety guidelines.
While visiting temples and sacred sites, modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is required, and footwear must be removed where instructed.
Showing respect towards religious places and the Thai Royal Family is extremely important, and inappropriate behaviour can attract penalties.
Thailand has a hot and humid climate, so light clothing, sunglasses, hats, and regular hydration are advisable.
Comfortable footwear is recommended, as many sightseeing spots involve walking on uneven paths, beaches, or steps.
Tap water is not considered safe for drinking; sealed bottled water should be used at all times.
Cash is commonly used in local markets, taxis, and small eateries, while cards are widely accepted in hotels, malls, and major attractions.
Bargaining is common in street markets and night bazaars, but not practised in shopping malls or branded outlets.
Traffic in cities like Bangkok and Phuket can be unpredictable, so travellers should keep a buffer time for airport transfers and tours.
Buying a local SIM card at the airport can be helpful for navigation, ride bookings, and staying connected.
Travellers should remain mindful of their personal belongings in crowded areas, beaches, and nightlife zones.
Carrying or using e-cigarettes, drugs, or restricted substances is strictly prohibited and can lead to heavy fines or legal consequences.
Having travel insurance that covers medical emergencies, water activities, and delays is strongly recommended for a smooth travel experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome to Phuket, a perfect beginning to your family getaway. Upon arrival at Phuket International Airport, get driven to your hotel & check in. The rest of the day is at leisure, where you can head out for a sunset walk along Patong Beach, where golden skies & gentle waves create a stunning backdrop for family photos. You may also enjoy a cozy beachfront dinner or explore the vibrant atmosphere around Bangla Road, experiencing Phuket’s lively nightlife.

days.title: Excursion to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: Set out for an island journey to the Phi Phi Islands, known for their dramatic limestone cliffs. Board a speedboat from Rassada Pier and explore the world-famous Maya Bay, admired for its stunning crescent shoreline and cinematic charm. You can swim  in the emerald waters of Pileh Lagoon and capture amazing pictures with friendly monkeys at Monkey Beach. Continue to Phi Phi Don, Bamboo Island, and Khai Nok Island famous for snorkeling and sunbathing. Later, get transferred back to the hotel.

days.title: Phuket City Tour | Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: After check-out, begin a scenic city tour of Phuket. Visit the Phuket Big Buddha, a serene hilltop landmark offering panoramic island views—perfect for family photos. Continue to Samet Nangshe Viewpoint, known for its breathtaking vistas of turquoise bays and coastline. Also, stroll through Phuket Old Town, admired for its colorful Sino-Portuguese architecture, cozy cafés, & vibrant street ambience. Later, get driven to Krabi & upon arrival, check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 7 Island Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to Krabi Pier for the Krabi 7-Island Sunset Tour aboard a speedboat, exploring some of the region’s most stunning islands. Cruise past pristine beaches and limestone cliffs. You can swim or snorkel in crystal-clear waters, then witness the glow of luminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline. Conclude the day with a traditional Thai dinner served via Song Taew, creating a perfect blend of adventure, nature, and local flavors. Later, get driven to the hotel.

days.title: Fly to Bangkok | Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to the airport & board your flight to Bangkok, Thailand’s vibrant capital. Upon arrival, proceed to your hotel for check-in. In the evening, get driven to the Asiatique Pier & board the famous Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise. Once aboard, enjoy a lavish buffet & live entertainment while cruising along the river, admiring the illuminated skyline. Glide past iconic landmarks such as the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, enjoying an unforgettable evening atmosphere.

days.desc: In the morning, get driven to spend a fun-filled day at Safari World & Marine Park Bangkok, Thailand’s premier wildlife and entertainment destination. Also, explore safari zones to see exotic animals up close and enjoy a delicious included lunch. After an amazing time, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
